Hi Bria,

Thanks for applying to the Platform Engineer role — I’m Irene on the recruiting team at Redwood Inference. I’d love to set up a quick 20-minute phone screen to learn more about your background and give you a short overview of the role and team.

I’m based in San Francisco (PST). Below are three 20-minute windows — I included the London times for convenience since your resume lists London:

- Wed, Jan 20 — 08:30–08:50 PST / 16:30–16:50 GMT
- Wed, Jan 20 — 11:00–11:20 PST / 19:00–19:20 GMT
- Thu, Jan 21 — 07:00–07:20 PST / 15:00–15:20 GMT

If none of those work, feel free to propose two slots that do (I’ll confirm quickly). We’ll do a short technical + role fit conversation — 20 minutes total.

Also let me know whether you prefer Google Meet or a phone call and what number you’d like us to use.

Best,
